scope: SVC-07 Core cooperative drain only; synthetic native peers, real SQLite
initial_failures: Two helper failures called nonexistent runtime.receipt; corrected to journal.get_receipt. No product change needed for those failures.

lint.comparison: same filename/code/message multisets; shifted line numbers ignored

durable_change: Additive operation_actions metadata, atomic with admission, no receipt/hash changes; legacy missing metadata stays unknown. No inferred backfill.

contract.begin_drain: sync owner-loop fence only; idempotent, no close/interrupt/renewal
contract.drain_status: passive bounded read; RUNNING/BUSY/UNKNOWN/QUIESCENT, quiescent boolean, metadata resources
contract.bounds: 256 rows + sentinel per journal query and 256 resources; one shared read per runtime, one-second await budget
contract.preserved: current authorized native decisions, interrupt/close, events/ack/reconciliation and authorized receipt replay
contract.composition: drain_status includes owned_sessions and activity_revision; drain_revision() is a synchronous memory-only token. combine_drain_status(reports) may resolve only exact claims retained by one other owner of the SAME journal. Host checks all revisions after all awaits. Missing fields, orphan, opening mismatch or duplicate owners stay UNKNOWN.

limitations: Not a proof of process death or future inactivity.
Legacy unknown action, uncertain native outcome, missing ACK or unresolved ownership remains non-quiescent.
No real provider, personal credentials, OS service campaign, wheel build, commit or push by this agent.
An empty runtime set does not prove an empty historical journal; the host must inspect its already-owned journal or remain UNKNOWN.
qualification_boundary: 209 prior regression identities passed before additive public composition delta; 50 directly affected identities passed after it, including 8 new shared-journal cases. No claim of one immutable 217-case run.
